input_manifest_rule: UTF-8 bytes of name|bytes|uppercase_sha256 plus LF in declared order

formulas.active_five_turnover_retention_selection: candidate_closed_lifecycles / sum(control selection closes excluding disabled Passive)
formulas.ratio: candidate metric / control metric only when both values are strictly positive
formulas.component_sum_reconciliation: Close counts must match exactly. Component money is source-disclosed to cents, so an aggregate must fall within one half-cent of display rounding per component plus 1e-7.

strict_economic_gates: Candidate selection actual and doubled-cost net each strictly exceed the exact active Live control.
Candidate selection actual/stressed net per close each strictly exceed control.

Candidate full forward actual and stressed net are strictly positive while each strictly exceeds control.
Candidate full forward actual/stressed net per close each strictly exceed control.
Candidate forward native equity DD remains below 20%; candidate selection exact 20.256887565% retains its already-recorded pragmatic qualification and nominal miss disclosure.
The prior fixed 4x cost comparison retains its exact pass verdict, candidate selection/control ratio and positive candidate forward advantage.
required_disclosures: Candidate versus control selection and forward close counts and turnover retention.
Selection candidate versus control native DD ratio and percentage-point increase.
Forward candidate versus control native DD percentage-point increase.
